title: Sunset runtime tacticals & triage
content:
quick notes (sunset shift)
---
Top-level goal: get p99 under 110ms for small-chat route by end of week. focused on KV-cache behavior when conversation length > 1024 tokens and multi-request prefix hits.

Observations:
- noticed p99 spikes correlate with convs where user used long system messages + repeated tool calls. KV cache size growth looks correct but lookup latency increases ~1.8x.
- swap pressure: on nodes with 40GB free GPU mem we still saw CPU page-in events (rare) during GC windows. could be CUDA memory fragmentation?
- microbatcher shows sudden batching delay (20-40ms extra) when queue bursts and slot scheduling flips to fairness mode.

Repro steps (minimal):
1) run local microbench (devbox) with small-chat workload: ./tools/loadgen --profile small-chat --qps 45 --duration 8m --concurrency 16
2) seed dataset: scripts/fixtures/long-system-msgs.json (use seed 42)
3) attach hotpath perf: sudo perf record -F 200 -g -p $(pgrep runtime) for 60s then perf report
4) enable KV cache debug: export RW_KV_DEBUG=1 and tail /var/log/rw/kv-debug.log

Hypotheses:
- KV lookup cost goes up because of repeated eviction/reinsertion churn when prefix maturity < 3 (i.e., short-lived prefixes). caching policy might be preserving less valuable entries due to our current score function (freq * recentness) — recentness weight too high.
- microbatch scheduler fairness threshold at 200ms causes rebalancing thrash. need to add hysteresis or decay window.
- rare kernel-level ioctl delays: observed a few blocked syscalls in strace (futex contention) during heavy scheduler churn. investigate SRE kernel tuning flags (see below).

Quick fixes to try (timeboxed):
- change KV score formula locally: score = freq * (1 + 0.5 * age_factor) -> reduces recentness bias. (30m)
- bump microbatch fairness threshold from 200ms -> 350ms and add 50ms jitter (1h)
- add small backoff before reinsertion on evicted entries (200us random) to avoid stampede (45m)
- kernel: toggle vm.swappiness to 10 on test fleet and measure (15m + test window)

Telemetry / checks to add to dashboard:
- add a per-prefix lifetime histogram (buckets: <1s, 1-10s, 10-60s, 60s+)
- track KV insertion vs eviction rate per-minute and percentage of reinsertions within 30s
- microbatch queue slot contention metric (waiting-time histogram)

Patch sketch (notes to self):
- edit runtime/kv/cache_policy.cc -> expose weight config via env RW_KV_SCORE_AGE_W (default 0.5). add unit tests for score monotonicity.
- runtime/batching/scheduler.cc -> add hysteresis timer, fallback path that prefers throughput windows. add integration test that simulates bursty arrivals.
- small e2e: use dockers warmed to reproduce. record baseline before each change.

Open tickets to link/triage:
- SRV-887: investigate p99 regressions small-chat (assigned: Lina)
- SRV-902: microbatch fairness knob (candidate quickfix)
- GH#4123: kv cache debug log flooding patch (PR in draft)

Meeting notes (15:30 with Lina & Ravi)
- Lina: will run fleet run with vm.swappiness toggle + measure paging stats.
- Ravi: will instrument KV to emit per-prefix lifetime histogram (prom endpoint) by EOD.
- me (Jade): implement local KV score change and run microbench; if p99 improves by >8% candidate for canary.

Tiny TODOs (sorted):
- [ ] fork runtime repo and add score env var (Jade)
- [ ] write quick microbench script that toggles fairness knob (Jade)
- [ ] ask infra to snapshot one test node before kernel tweaks (Ravi)
- [ ] add dashboard panels for reinsertion percentage (Ravi)
- [ ] update perf-run runbook with perf flags we used today (Lina)

Notes-to-self (random):
- remember: long system prompts from product tests may not be realistic traffic. create a mixed-fraction load (10% long prompts) for next run.
- if we touch kernel flags, run safety window at low qps first. avoid cluster-wide toggles without a rollback plan.
- record exact env used for canary in PR description.

Evening quick wins (if time):
- add jittered backoff reinsertion (should be low risk)
- add a simple prometheus label to kv_inserts: prefix_type=(user|system|tool) to slice influence.

End-of-shift wrap:
- baseline p99 before changes: 132ms (observed 2025-11-03 18:20 PST)
- target p99: <110ms; realistic interim: <120ms for canary
- next steps morning: collate perf flame graphs, push small PR for env var, then schedule canary.

Random scratch lines:
- kernel: futex waits show up during GC windows; maybe tune pthread_mutex attr?
- check for recent glibc changes in our base image (last updated Oct 2025)
- Slack thread: #runtime-p99 has a note from @maria earlier about similar KV churn (search)

-- jade
